systemOverview.name: cFish.io Workbench System
systemOverview.description: A standardized structure for active work and upcoming tasks across all departments and key directories within the cFish.io digital workspace
purpose: Provide clearly designated areas for active work across all departments
Standardize the location of in-progress items throughout the workspace
Separate active development from completed/archived content
Create a consistent approach to documenting work in progress
Enhance cross-department collaboration through uniform structure
Improve discoverability of active projects and related documentation
Establish a hierarchical structure for organization-wide initiatives
Create a foundation for future automation and reporting
benefits: Improved organization with clearly designated areas for active work
Better cross-department collaboration through uniform structure
Consistent documentation of work in progress
Clear framework for both department-specific and organization-wide initiatives
Foundation for future automation and reporting
Reduced clutter by separating active development from completed content
Improved tracking with consistent memory and changelog files

addingItems: Identify the appropriate workbench based on item's primary department/function
Add the item to the 'active' subfolder (maintain 1-3 item limit)
Create a README file in the 'WB-readme' subfolder following naming convention: [item-name]-README.md
Update WB-memory.md with date of addition, brief description, expected timeline, and dependencies or related items
workingWithItems: Always work with items in the workbench location, not duplicated elsewhere
Update README files to reflect current progress

For cross-department collaboration, keep the item in the primary responsible department's workbench, create symbolic links in secondary departments' workbenches if needed, and document the connection in both workbench memory files
completingItems: Document completion in item's README file
Move item from 'active' to its permanent location following UcF structure
Document in WB-memory.md: completion date, final location, and any follow-up tasks
Move the highest priority item from 'next-WB' to 'active'
managingMasterWorkbench: The master workbench (cFish-WB) should only contain organization-wide initiatives
All master workbench items should have clear connections to department workbenches
Regular review of the master workbench should be conducted by all department heads
Only cross-departmental projects should be placed in the master workbench
Documentation in the master workbench should reference related department workbench items
